summary: Dependency-confusion stub beacons installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at install and import
details: Package ships as a stub described as a 'compatibility shim' whose exported module is a no-op Proxy. The tarball contains beacon.cjs, which is invoked both from a postinstall lifecycle hook and from the main module's top-level code. On each trigger it collects installer host identifiers (os.hostname(), __dirname install path, process.cwd(), process.version) and POSTs them over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. No functional code is shipped alongside the beacon — the exfiltration is the package's sole behavior. The scoped name @ppa-web-components/ppa-builder, combined with the stub/no-op export, is consistent with a dependency-confusion squat targeting an internal package of the same name, causing installers who intend to resolve the internal package to instead install this stub and trigger the beacon at both install and require time.
